tenderSchedule.title: BTPS (1X500MW) Fabrication and installation work of JB boxes for critical motors of Unit 1, 2 & 3
tenderSchedule.description: Fabrication, installation of Junction Box (JB) for critical motors of unit-1, 2 & 3 consisting of copper Busbar and suitable support insulator current rating 92Amperes to 255 Ampere please refer tender document for more details,
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer LT Office BTPS Bellary

generalCriterionList.description: Intending bidders shold pay an amount in Rs.21,150 Rupees Twenty-One Thousand One Hundred and Fifty only towards Earnest Money Deposit

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intended bidder in his name should have satisfactorily executed the electrical work pertaining to any electrical panel fabrication & installation works as a Prime contractor in a single work order for an amount of not less than Rs 4.23 lakhs in any ONE year during preceding Five years (2021-22 to 2025-26). Work order and Work done/Work completion certificate issued by competent authority shall be uploaded. Cost of completed works of previous years will be given ten percentage of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level limited to 40%.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work done certificate and work order

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall hold a valid Class-II or above Electrical contractor license issued by Electrical Inspectorate

The intended bidder in his name shall have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 8.46 Lakhs (excluding GST) in the last preceding Five years (2021-22 to 2025-26) and furnish Certified copy of statement of accounts issued by charted accountant shall be uploaded as documentary evidence. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given ten percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level limited to 40%.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Registration of Establishment/firm/ company/ individual from Govt. authority, Department of Labour
PF Registration with Regional Provident Fund Commissioner

The declaration by the bidder that none of his contracts have been terminated / foreclosed by KPCL or elsewhere on account of his default during the last 03 years shall be furnished / uploaded. Declaration shall be furnished in format as in Annexure III of this bid document.
The declaration as at Annexure IV of this bid document shall be furnished
The bidder shall furnish schedule of general particulars as per Annexure V of this bid document
